summary: An operational alert seam: events rendered to plain text, deduplicated and paced by an Alerter, sent through a Notifier (Telegram and log adapters), fed by a slog tee.
use_when: a service must tell its owner in a chat message that something broke (5xx, recovered panic, failed job)
error-level log records should become deduplicated, paced alerts through a slog tee
a producer that is not a log call (crash report, cron tick) must submit an event
not_for: metrics, tracing or dashboards: use a metrics or tracing stack
log shipping or aggregation: use a log pipeline
paging with escalation or on-call rotation: use an incident tool
alerting across several processes: dedup state lives in one process
